scope: Primary conference or proceedings pages used for metadata and method-boundary checks; local fixed source files used for exact VMem implementation claims.

primary_literature.title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
primary_literature.used_for: Exact baseline identity and surfel-indexed history retrieval; implementation details were separately checked in the pinned local source.

primary_literature.title: EasyRef: Omni-Generalized Group Image Reference for Diffusion Models via Multimodal LLM
primary_literature.used_for: Direct prior art on limitations of averaging or concatenating multiple reference-image embeddings and learned group-image interaction.

primary_literature.title: WorldMem: Long-term Consistent World Simulation with Memory
primary_literature.used_for: Token-level frame memory bound to pose and time, with state-aware cross-attention after retrieval.

primary_literature.title: Improving Autoregressive Video Modeling with History Understanding
primary_literature.used_for: Direct evidence that history-representation quality is already an explicit VideoAR research problem; masked history modeling is a learned mechanism.

primary_literature.title: Align Images Before You Generate
primary_literature.used_for: Native correspondence construction and aligned-area aggregation in multi-image diffusion; pressure against claiming correspondence masks or local aggregation alone as novelty.

primary_literature.title: WorldStereo: Bridging Camera-Guided Video Generation and Scene Reconstruction via 3D Geometric Memories
primary_literature.used_for: Direct nearest work: 2D memory bank plus incrementally aligned 3D cache; Global-Geometric Memory supplies coarse structure and camera control, while Spatial-Stereo Memory uses 3D correspondence to constrain target-reference attention for fine detail.

primary_literature.title: Spatia: Video Generation with Updatable Spatial Memory
primary_literature.used_for: Direct prior art on persistent point-cloud spatial memory, visual-SLAM or MapAnything updates from generated frames, trajectory-rendered projection video, and ControlNet conditioning.

primary_literature.title: Geometry-as-context: Modulating Explicit 3D in Scene-consistent Video Generation to Geometry Context
primary_literature.used_for: Direct prior art on interleaved RGB-geometry context and Camera Gated Attention, where Plucker camera features modulate the self-attention query and output gate.

primary_literature.title: Rethinking Position Embedding as a Context Controller for Multi-Reference and Multi-Shot Video Generation
primary_literature.used_for: PoCo and SideInfo-RoPE: direct prior art on using reference identifiers as side information to control Q-K association while preserving full attention connectivity without additional memory or computational overhead.

adjacent_primary_literature.title: Movie Weaver: Tuning-Free Multi-Concept Video Personalization with Anchored Prompts
adjacent_primary_literature.used_for: Per-reference concept embeddings and anchored prompt binding.

adjacent_primary_literature.title: MS-Diffusion: Multi-subject Zero-shot Image Personalization with Layout Guidance
adjacent_primary_literature.used_for: Layout-guided multi-subject cross-attention and per-subject grounding.

adjacent_primary_literature.title: Mixture of Contexts for Long Video Generation
adjacent_primary_literature.used_for: Learned sparse attention routing over history chunks and anchors.

adjacent_primary_literature.title: Trust but Verify: Adaptive Conditioning for Reference-Based Diffusion Super-Resolution via Implicit Reference Correlation Modeling
adjacent_primary_literature.used_for: Adaptive reference-correlation gating and suppression of misleading references.

adjacent_primary_literature.title: SPAD: Spatially Aware Multi-View Diffusers
adjacent_primary_literature.used_for: Earlier prior art on epipolar-constrained cross-view self-attention and Plucker ray positional embeddings.

adjacent_primary_literature.title: EpiDiff: Enhancing Multi-View Synthesis via Localized Epipolar-Constrained Diffusion
adjacent_primary_literature.used_for: Earlier prior art on lightweight epipolar attention in a frozen diffusion model, including Near-Views Cross-Attention and Ray Self-Attention for localized geometric feature aggregation.

retrieval_limit: The search was targeted rather than survey-complete. No directly overlapping paper retrieved does not establish novelty.
